CardDescription.DefaultText: An elevated pine grove with tall, straight trees spaced among moss-covered rocks, offering clear views across the surrounding landscape.

CardHelpSection.DefaultText: Pine Grove: Conditions: Acidic soil. Windy. Flora: Pines, Healer's Moss, Fireroot, Bilberries (summer), Pine Nuts (autumn), Fly Agaric. Fauna: Squirrels, Partridges, Foxes, Does, Stags, Wolves.
